about:
46Solutions is based in Lexington, Kentucky, and operates as a 100% employee-owned technology services firm. The company provides IT, cybersecurity, and audio/video solutions for businesses and homes across central Kentucky.

The firm delivers a range of managed IT services including cybersecurity, network consulting, cloud management, VoIP phone systems, and digital signage. On the residential side, it designs and installs home theaters, outdoor entertainment systems, TV and projector setups, and whole-home automation. With a staff of about 100 and over 300 years of combined team experience, 46Solutions serves small to medium-sized businesses and households throughout the Lexington, Louisville, and surrounding county areas.

Clients come from sectors such as financial services, construction, and physical security. The company cites work with Alltech on a video wall installation and with Silent Guard Security for managed IT and conference-room technology. It also supports residential customers seeking custom home entertainment and automation.

46Solutions emphasizes its employee-ownership model and SOC 2 Type II certification as key differentiators, along with 24/7 phone and email support and recognition as a top IT firm in the Lexington market.

name: 4C Medical Technologies, Inc.
old_description: WE’VE CREATED A NEW GENERATION OF MINIMALLY INVASIVE TECHNOLOGIES FOR STRUCTURAL HEART DISEASE
about:
Based in Maple Grove, Minnesota, 4C Medical Technologies, Inc. develops minimally invasive technologies for structural heart disease. The company focuses on transcatheter mitral valve replacement, though its founding year and ownership structure have not been publicly disclosed.

Its lead product, the AltaValve™ system, is a supra-annular transcatheter mitral valve replacement (TMVR) designed to treat mitral regurgitation. The device is investigational, limited by U.S. federal law to investigational use, and the company supports clinical research through a dedicated participation program. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes have been disclosed.

The company serves the cardiovascular medical device sector, targeting interventional cardiologists, cardiac surgeons, and research institutions. Its technology has been featured in peer-reviewed publications such as JACC, JACC: Case Reports, and Expert Review of Medical Devices, and it has received recognition including first place at Cardiovascular Research Technologies and a Best Technology Parade Presentation award.

4C Medical states that AltaValve is the first mitral regurgitation therapy to expand the treatable patient population, streamline the procedure, and preserve critical cardiac structures, differentiating it from other TMVR approaches.

about:
Based in Tea, South Dakota, 605 Clothing takes its name from the state’s 605 area code. The company designs, develops, and produces a range of branded apparel and accessories from its Midwestern location, with a showroom housed at the affiliated Octane Ink facility.

The product line includes graphic t-shirts, hoodies, caps, and leather-wrapped tumblers, organized under collections such as PinHigh Golf and Vintage Tee. Most orders are manufactured on demand, while a selection of stock is kept in the showroom for immediate purchase. The company also operates a direct-to-consumer e-commerce site and offers wholesale programs for retail partners.

Customers include individual consumers purchasing through the website and retail stores seeking to carry 605 Clothing’s South Dakota-themed lifestyle and golf apparel. Wholesale inquiries are directed to a dedicated email contact, and the company promotes its products as “swag you actually want to wear.”

The brand emphasizes its local roots, positioning its merchandise as uniquely South Dakotan and produced in-house rather than outsourced overseas. This domestic, on-demand model is presented as a differentiator for both retail partners and end customers.

name: 74C Meat Co.
old_description: Delivery, taxes, and discount codes are calculated at checkout
about:
74C Meat Co. operates from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, with its family ranch located in nearby Guthrie. The company takes its name from State Highway 74C, the road that has long connected the ranch to the broader market. Founded as a family-owned operation, the business raises and processes its own livestock on the Guthrie property.

The company produces pasture-raised beef, pork, and chicken, all processed under USDA inspection. Product lines include steaks, roasts, ground beef, bacon, sausages, whole chickens, snack sticks, rendered beef tallow, and eggs. 74C Meat Co. sells directly to consumers through home delivery and free on-farm pickup, and also runs a monthly subscription club that delivers a curated box of meats worth approximately $400.

Customers are primarily households seeking direct-from-the-ranch meat, served through the company's e-commerce site with scheduled delivery dates. The subscription model caters to recurring buyers, while a la carte options allow one-time purchases. No commercial or wholesale channels are described in the available information.

The brand emphasizes "Uncompromising Quality: A Promise, Not A Label," highlighting its pasture-raised practices, Oklahoma roots, family ownership, and USDA inspection as differentiators. The highway namesake reflects the company's origin story: a rural ranch bridging the gap between pasture and doorstep.

name: A & H Manufacturing Co
old_description: For over 50 years, A&H Manufacturing Worldwide has provided the world’s largest retailers with superior
about:
A&H Manufacturing Worldwide, based in Johnston, Rhode Island, traces its roots to 1967 when jewelry salesman H. Jack Feibelman invented the hanging jewelry card, a design that became an industry standard. The company remained under Feibelman family leadership until 2022, when ownership transitioned to the Calandrelli family—Anthony and Daniel Calandrelli—who bring decades of packaging experience and continue the founder's legacy of customer-focused innovation.

The company designs, engineers, and manufactures custom product packaging across four facilities worldwide. Its capabilities span carding, hang tags and tickets, boxes, labels, e-commerce packaging, molded specialty items, gift packaging, eco-friendly solutions, puff pads, and pouches. In-house design, engineering, and research teams handle projects from concept through production and delivery, serving both large retailers and smaller brands.

A&H serves a diverse client base that includes the world's largest retailers as well as businesses in jewelry, apparel, accessories, tools, hardware, and wine. The firm's packaging solutions are tailored to each product category, with an emphasis on brand storytelling and functional fit.

Feibelman's original insight—"When you can't find what you're looking for, you invent it"—still drives the company's approach. A&H differentiates itself through Made-in-USA production that reduces transportation emissions, a sustainability program that re-engineers packages to use less material, and a customer service model built on timely communication and creative problem-solving.

name: A & L Furniture
old_description: Handmade beds of many styles, colors and stains, including twin, full and hanging swing beds.
about:
A & L Furniture operates from Rebersburg, Pennsylvania, where it produces a family of furniture brands. The company does not disclose its founding year or the names of its founders, and its ownership structure is not publicly specified.

The company manufactures a wide range of indoor and outdoor furniture under several brand names. Versaloft offers beds, bunkbeds, loft beds, mission beds, trundle beds, and drawer beds. Unique Hickory Furniture produces dining tables, chairs, bar stools, rockers, gliders, coffee tables, end tables, desks, and porch swings using hand-selected hickory. Bryton Park specializes in outdoor furniture made from eco-friendly recycled plastic poly lumber, including chairs, tables, stools, rockers, benches, side tables, porch swings, daybeds, bar tables, bistro sets, and picnic tables. Blue Mountain Live Edge works with durable, rot-resistant live edge locust hardwood for porch swings, flower pot benches, outdoor chairs, side tables, coffee tables, Ridgemont tables and benches, and picnic tables. Cedar Canyon builds outdoor cedar furniture such as pergolas, picnic tables, benches, swings, gliders, Adirondack chairs, and tables. Processes emphasize handmade construction, hand-selection of materials, and finishing in various colors and stains. No facility size, headcount, production volumes, or part numbers are disclosed.

Customer reviews on the company website describe purchases by individual homeowners — gliders, rockers, and picnic tables — indicating a direct-to-consumer channel. The company may also supply retailers, though no commercial clients are named.

A & L Furniture highlights its handmade approach, with materials hand-selected for each piece, and offers eco-friendly outdoor lines made from recycled plastic poly lumber and rot-resistant live edge locust hardwood, marketed as built to last for generations.

about:
A & S Electric Supply operates from a facility on Polk Street in Newark, New Jersey. The company provides electrical and lighting supplies to customers across the region, serving as a local source for contractors and facility managers.

The distributor stocks a range of electrical components including circuit breakers, push buttons, wires, fittings, switches, and portable power supplies. It offers same-day delivery service to job sites and operates weekdays from 6 AM to 5 PM with Saturday hours until noon, catering to early-start construction schedules.

Its customer base includes construction crews needing electrical products for equipment and building installations, industrial building managers requiring wiring and repair supplies, laboratories using circuit breakers and push buttons for component assembly, and field workers relying on portable power when grid electricity is unavailable. The company notes that it addresses the unique requirements of larger industries while also accommodating smaller-scale projects.

The company emphasizes same-day delivery and early opening hours to help contractors and maintenance teams keep projects on schedule, positioning itself as a reliable partner for time-sensitive electrical supply needs.

name: A List Woodworks
old_description: Contract Manufacturing, Laminating and Fabrication of Component Parts, Retail Store Displays, Shelving, Speaker Cabinets & More
about:
A List Woodworks operates from a 40,000-square-foot facility in Whitinsville, Massachusetts. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides contract manufacturing, laminating, and fabrication of wood and plastic panel products. Its 10,000-square-foot production floor houses a Holzma CNC panel saw, a Heian four-head CNC production router, and an Adwood edgebander, supported by a 5,000-square-foot paint and coatings department with fiberglass and Chemline capabilities. Services include cut-to-size panel processing, CNC routing, edgebanding, V-folding, T-slotting, T-molding insertion, graphic panels, polyurea extreme-duty coatings, acrylic machining, and speaker enclosure assembly. The facility also offers 25,000 square feet of warehousing for just-in-time delivery, handling volumes from prototype to large production runs.

A List Woodworks serves customers in retail store displays, shelving, speaker cabinets, and general component parts manufacturing. Typical clients include OEMs and retailers needing wood, melamine, plastic, foam, or acrylic components such as speaker enclosures, retail fixtures, and veneer plywood shelving.

The company positions its automated facility as a way for customers to save time and money, increase production capabilities, speed turnaround, and improve quality without hiring or training additional staff. It emphasizes helping clients control growth by instantly expanding production capacity without significant capital investment.
